_comment: Extra TUI display models beyond the SDK catalog in internal/providers/registry.go. The SDK catalog now carries up to 10 current models per provider, so this file is intentionally empty; add entries here only for display-only models the SDK should not know about (fields: id, name, context_window, default_max_tokens, can_reason, supports_images). Ollama stays empty — models come from live /api/tags detection at runtime. The first model of the merged list is the provider default, the last one the small model.
